readyMade.label: Ready-made patterns
readyMade.helpText: Switch on the ones you want. Each shows its title, then the regex it uses.

builtinBuySub.label: Offers to buy, sell or monetize your subreddit:

builtinTradeSubs.label: Buying or selling subreddits for money:

builtinPayForPost.label: "Allow this post and I'll pay you":

builtinPayYou.label: Any offer to pay the moderators:

patterns.label: Your own regex patterns (one per line)
patterns.helpText: Optional. A modmail that matches a ready-made pattern you switched on, or any line here, triggers the actions below. Write a bare pattern (case-insensitive) or /pattern/flags. Lines starting with # are ignored.

firstMessageOnly.label: Only check the first message of a conversation
firstMessageOnly.helpText: Turn off to also check every later reply from the user.

exemptUsers.label: Exempt users (one per line)
exemptUsers.helpText: The app never bans or mutes these users, and takes them off its permanent-mute list.

banReason.label: Ban reason (shown to moderators, max 100 characters)

banMessage.label: Ban message sent to the user (optional, max 1000 characters)

muteDuration.label: Mute length
muteDuration.helpText: Reddit does not let apps set a true permanent mute, so both Permanent choices are workarounds. Recurring: the app renews a 28-day mute shortly before it ends; Reddit sends the user a mute notice each time, which apps cannot turn off (the user can mute notifications for that chat). Auto-archive: no further mutes or notices; after the first 28 days the app archives whatever they send. A muted account can still message moderators directly outside modmail.

options.label: Permanent: auto-archive by username after 28 days

recurringMuteTip.label: Recurring mutes: tell the user once how to silence the renewal notices
recurringMuteTip.helpText: Reddit notifies the user every time the mute is renewed, about every four weeks. When the recurring mute starts, the app sends them the message below.

recurringMuteMessage.label: Recurring mutes: message sent to the user
recurringMuteMessage.defaultValue: You have been muted from contacting the moderators of this community, and the mute renews automatically. Reddit will send you a mute notice each time, about every four weeks. If you would rather not be notified, you can mute notifications for this conversation in your chat window.

addModNote.label: Leave a private moderator note in the conversation saying what matched

archive.label: Archive the conversation afterwards
archive.helpText: Takes it out of the inbox and marks it read for all moderators. Apps cannot move a conversation to the Filtered folder.

summaryFrequency.label: Send a summary to modmail
summaryFrequency.helpText: Lists who the app acted on and why. It is only sent when the app acted at least once in the period.

undoAll.label: Undo everything the app has done
undoAll.helpText: Warning: while this is switched on, the app unbans and unmutes everyone it banned or muted, moves the conversations it archived back to your inbox, empties its permanent-mute list, and takes no new action. Bans or mutes a moderator has since changed are left alone. Private notes and messages the app already sent cannot be removed. You get a modmail when it has finished. Switch this off to let the app work again.
